user.title: Connect V380 Cloud
user.description: Enter your V380 Pro cloud account credentials. Cloud protocol support is experimental. Camera credentials used for a local connection are different from cloud account credentials.

data.allow_insecure_http: Allow unencrypted legacy cloud recording access

data_description.username: The account used to sign in to V380 Pro.
data_description.password: The password used to sign in to that cloud account.
data_description.allow_insecure_http: Off by default. Some legacy V380 recording services require HTTP. Enabling this can send cloud credentials or tokens unencrypted to the vendor.
